basic_info.description: Stunning full-floor, 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom condominium is located in a prime Pacific Heights boutique Art Deco building, just steps from Lafayette Park. The grand and spacious living room features a fireplace and built-in bookshelves, and flows into an elegant formal dining room adjacent to the charming kitchen. The large, sunny master bedroom includes an ensuite bathroom, while the beautiful second bedroom offers direct access to a private, spacious deck overlooking a lush garden. Additional features include a third bedroom/office, a second full bathroom, high ceilings, hardwood floors, an in-unit washer and dryer, ample closets, deeded garage parking, and extra storage space. 1969 Clay Street is a walker's paradise, with close proximity to shops, restaurants, and excellent transit options, including city bus lines and tech shuttle stops. https://websites.open.homes/preview/1f00cf85-15f5-6d32-8b30-02ffd8b76bfd/mls/4/?m=0
